disclaimer: Synthetic samples are vectors in the anonymised PCA feature space (V1-V28) plus Amount, generated by a VAE trained on normal transactions. They are not real or interpretable transaction records: the original features and PCA loadings were never published, so rows cannot be mapped to merchants, cards, places or customers. No fraud label is attached. Source data: Credit Card Fraud Detection, ULB MLG / Worldline (Kaggle mlg-ulb/creditcardfraud), ODbL 1.0 / DbCL 1.0; Dal Pozzolo et al., CIDM 2015.
